title: Urology and Continence Supply Program: patient cost-share schedule by payer program
content:
Each tier of the Urology and Continence Supply Program carries the cost-share terms of the payer program behind the coverage it bills. The schedule below states those terms for all six tiers.

## Terms of the schedule

1. **Coinsurance** is the patient's share, in whole percent, of the payer-allowed amount on each claim line after any deductible. On the Continence Self-Pay Program it is the share of the Larkfield cash price that the customer pays.
2. **Copay per 30-day supply** is a flat patient copay, in USD, that the plan applies to each 30-day supply on a claim line. A figure of 0.00 USD means the plan applies no copay. The copay informs the expected patient responsibility, which the payer's remittance then confirms.
3. **Deductible applies** states whether the plan's annual deductible applies to this product line before coinsurance. The deductible amount itself belongs to the payer and arrives on the remittance; Larkfield holds no deductible figure of its own.
4. **Crossover to secondary** states whether the patient responsibility the primary payer leaves is crossed over automatically to an in-effect secondary coverage before any patient statement.

## Schedule

| Basis | Continence Self-Pay Program | Continence Commercial HMO Program | Continence Commercial PPO Program | Continence Medicare Advantage Program | Continence Original Medicare Program | Continence Medicaid Program |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Coinsurance | 100 percent | 0 percent | 20 percent | 20 percent | 20 percent | 0 percent |
| Copay per 30-day supply | 0.00 USD | 35.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD |
| Annual deductible applies before coinsurance | No | No | Yes | No | Yes | No |
| Automatic crossover to an in-effect secondary coverage | No | No | No | No | Yes | No |


## Reading the schedule

- A copay of 0.00 USD means the plan applies no copay on that tier. A coinsurance of 0 percent means the plan takes no coinsurance share on that tier.
- On the Continence Self-Pay Program the 100 percent figure means the customer pays the whole Larkfield cash price, because no payer shares the cost.
- Only the Continence Original Medicare Program crosses patient responsibility over to a secondary coverage automatically. On every other tier the crossover entry is No.

**Illustration (hypothetical figures).** Suppose a claim line has a payer-allowed amount of 50.00 USD after the deductible on a tier with 20 percent coinsurance and no copay. The expected coinsurance is 20 percent of 50.00 USD, which is 10.00 USD. The amount actually posted to the customer is what the payer's remittance shows.
